Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Sunset Blinds & Shades, LLC specializes in the design, supply, and installation of custom window treatments and blinds for residential and commercial clients. Our services include measuring and consulting to ensure optimal product selection, followed by professional installation performed by trained personnel. We focus on high-quality materials, such as fabrics and wood, and strictly adhere to safety and industry standards. All installations are executed without the use of unlicensed subcontractors, and we do not engage in the installation of motorized systems that require electrical work unless performed by certified electricians. Additionally, we are compliant with regulations prohibiting the use of lead-containing products in our offerings. Our commitment to secure inventory management and meticulous installation practices minimizes risks associated with theft, damage, and liability claims.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 06/15/2023, a claim was filed for accidental damage to a client's property during the installation process, resulting in repair costs of $3,000. The claim is currently under review and pending resolution. Additionally, on 08/10/2023, we experienced a theft of inventory valued at $12,000, involving custom blinds that were secure but subsequently stolen from our storage facility. This claim has been settled, and the amount was paid out in full. Both incidents highlight the importance of our stringent inventory management protocols.
